# Cobblemon: Extended Battle UI - German Translation

This resource pack adds a german translation for the [Cobblemon: Extended Battle UI](https://modrinth.com/mod/cobblemon-extended-battle-ui) mod by sveniik

## Contributing

If a translation is wrong or missing, please open an [issue](https://github.com/JavaRacing1/CobblemonExtendedBattleUI-German-Translation/issues) or [submit a pull request](https://github.com/JavaRacing1/CobblemonExtendedBattleUI-German-Translation/pulls)
